note: Grounded in langgraph_design.md node 'finalize' (audit write mandatory before response returns) and memory_design.md SS3-4 (what must/must-not persist).

scenarios.description: A completed run has a resolvable AgentRun record with trace_id and audit_record_id populated before the response was returned.
A response reached terminal_state=completed but audit_record_id is null -- finalize's own contract requires this to be non-optional; a response that skipped it is not a valid terminal state.
A blocked draft's record must carry a reason code and content hash, never the prohibited draft text itself (memory_design.md SS4).
Adversarial: a blocked-draft record that stored the prohibited text itself -- must fail; this is exactly what memory_design.md SS4 forbids.
